title: Geometric PDE, relativity, and fluid dynamics
summary: Elliptic and geometric PDE, Einstein constraint and mean-curvature problems, and fluid dynamics, including continuous data assimilation from partial velocity observations.

title: Numerical analysis and geometric discretization
summary: Adaptive finite and boundary element methods, including optimal W1p adaptivity, Banach-space relaxed quasi-orthogonality and inf-sup stable Galerkin methods; finite and discrete exterior calculus and wavelet approximation.

title: Approximation theory, adaptivity, and neural realization
summary: Nonlinear and multilevel approximation, refinable and subdivision schemes, and exact ReLU-network realizations of iterative one-dimensional and tensor-product refinement algorithms.

title: Quantum fields and computational regularization
summary: Dynamical lattice regulators for Euclidean quantum field theory, with rotational symmetry and reflection positivity at finite cutoff; locality and universality are studied under explicit hypotheses.

title: Mathematical exposition, teaching, and computational tools
summary: Expository notes, bilingual teaching projects, calendar computations, and small computational tools for mathematics, physics, and scientific visualization.
